dedup_notes: EH2-001 == BH2-003 (split-brain override-shaped door; two hunters independently) and EH2-002 == BH2-001 (set -u unbound vars in the probe); deduplicated below to two findings

findings.finding_text: The EH-002 determinized lock-coalesce fixture kills the holder mid-reindex and asserts exactly ONE line — the round-1 rework deleted the proof that the holder COMPLETES its own cycle under contention and that the lock holds through contract/crossCheck/emit (a wrapper releasing fd 9 after stage [d] passes every current test)
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Handshake redesign: the holder's contract fake PARKS inside the contract stage until a release file the test writes after B's refusal is observed; the holder then completes crossCheck+emit on its own — assertions: holderExit 0 (completed, never killed), ordered 2-line sink [skip, success+match]. No fixed sleeps; bounded waits only. B's skip records the stamp current at B's tick (A's post-reindex stamp, REAL_HEAD — the park lives in contract, not reindex); the INCOMING-sha + stale-alarm skip arm stays pinned by the external-holder test

findings.finding_text: The BH-002 split-brain guard keys on override PRESENCE, not coherence — QDS_REFRESH_REINDEX_CMD='bash scripts/install-gitnexus-plus.sh' (the production default spelled explicitly) combined with a non-empty home passes the guard yet is the exact split-brain it exists to prevent (independently found by blind-hunter as BH2-003)
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Coherence arm: the guard additionally refuses a non-empty home when the reindex override REFERENCES the canonical writer (substring install-gitnexus-plus — spelling-tolerant: env-prefixed, absolute, ./ all caught); header env-table row + fakeReindex doc updated; two new tests (exact default spelling; env-prefixed absolute spelling)

findings.finding_text: The bun fallback probe dereferences $HOME (twice) and $PATH unguarded under set -u — an env -i / minimal-systemd invocation dies on 'HOME: unbound variable' exit 1 with no named FATAL, bypassing the exit-3 contract (independently found by blind-hunter as BH2-001)
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Conditional ${HOME:+...} probe entries (vanish when unset) + ${PATH:-/usr/bin:/bin} in the prepend; new test: HOME and PATH keys DELETED from the spawn env → exit 3, named FATAL, no side effects

findings.finding_text: The stripped-PATH FATAL test keeps unconditional exit-code and no-side-effect assertions while its own comment concedes a legitimate host class (flock on /usr/bin:/bin AND /usr/local/bin/bun) where the wrapper proceeds — the suite false-reds exactly where it has nothing to prove
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: it.skipIf(STRIPPED_PATH_HOST_PASSES_EVERYTHING) with the host condition named in a comment (house named-skip pattern); the FATAL contract stays pinned on missing-prereq hosts (macOS dev: flock leg; CI's setup-bun: bun leg)
